html:
1What You Will Learn

  • Describe the parts of an Amazon VPC: subnets, route tables and gateways
  • Compare security groups and network ACLs
  • Explain what Amazon Route 53 and Amazon CloudFront do
  • Choose among Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN and AWS Direct Connect
  • Place Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Global Accelerator and API Gateway

2The VPC, DNS and delivery

Running case

Tidewater Builds Its Network

  • Customers must reach the web servers, but nobody on the internet may reach the database
  • Servers in the private network must download updates without accepting outside connections
  • Visitors type a domain name, and customers in Europe need fast page loads
  • The warehouse must connect securely to the cloud, and some staff work from home
  • Your job: choose the network services

Amazon VPC: Your Private Network in AWS

  • Amazon VPC lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define
  • A VPC resembles a traditional network in your own data center, with the scalability of AWS
  • A subnet is a range of IP addresses that lives entirely in one Availability Zone; use several zones for resilience
  • Route tables decide where traffic goes; gateways connect the VPC to other networks
  • Every Region starts with a default VPC; a VPC has no additional charge, but parts such as NAT gateways do

Exam tip: A VPC is your isolated network, and each subnet lives in one Availability Zone.

Public and Private Subnets: Internet and NAT Gateways

Component What it does Typical use
Public subnet Has a route to an internet gateway; resources with public IP addresses can reach the internet and be reached Web servers, load balancers
Private subnet No direct route to an internet gateway Databases, application servers
Internet gateway Redundant, highly available link between the VPC and the internet; no charge Internet in and out
NAT gateway Lets private-subnet instances reach out, while the internet cannot start a connection to them; charges apply Updates for private servers
  • AWS recommends private subnets to protect your resources

Exam tip: Reach out but not be reached: NAT gateway. A direct internet path: internet gateway.

Security Groups and Network ACLs

Security group Network ACL (access control list)
Works at The resource, such as an EC2 instance The subnet
Rules Allow rules Allow and deny rules, checked in number order
State Stateful: replies to allowed traffic are allowed automatically Stateless: replies need their own rule
Role The main firewall for each resource An extra layer; the default one allows all traffic
  • Amazon Inspector also checks for unintended network exposure (Module 5)

Exam tip: Stateful and per resource: security group. Stateless, per subnet, with deny rules: network ACL.

Amazon Route 53: DNS and Health Checks

  • Amazon Route 53 is a highly available, scalable DNS web service
  • Domain registration: register names such as example.com
  • DNS routing: connects a browser that types your domain to your website or application
  • Health checking: sends automated requests to confirm a resource is reachable, notifies you and can route traffic away from unhealthy resources
  • Traffic Flow routes users by latency, geoproximity and health
  • VPC Resolver answers DNS queries inside your VPCs

Exam tip: Domain names and DNS routing: Amazon Route 53.

Amazon CloudFront: Faster Delivery Worldwide

  • Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that speeds up static and dynamic web content
  • Content comes from edge locations; each request goes to the one with the lowest latency
  • On a cache miss, CloudFront fetches the object from your origin: an Amazon S3 bucket or an HTTP server
  • Objects stay cached for 24 hours by default, and you can change that
  • A distribution tells CloudFront where your content comes from
  • You pay for data transfer out and requests; data from AWS origins into CloudFront is free

Exam tip: Deliver web content quickly to users worldwide: Amazon CloudFront.

Your Network to AWS: VPN and Direct Connect

  • AWS Site-to-Site VPN: an encrypted IPsec connection between your network and your VPC over the internet, with two tunnels per connection
  • AWS Client VPN: a managed, client-based VPN; individual users connect from anywhere with an OpenVPN-based client
  • AWS Direct Connect: a dedicated network connection from your site to AWS, bypassing internet service providers
  • Direct Connect bills port hours and outbound data transfer

Exam tip: Encrypted over the internet: VPN. A dedicated private line: AWS Direct Connect.

3Connecting networks, APIs and practice

Transit Gateway, PrivateLink and Global Accelerator

Service What it does Remember
AWS Transit Gateway A network transit hub that interconnects VPCs and on-premises networks through attachments Many networks, one hub
AWS PrivateLink Privately connects your VPC to services as if they were in it, with no internet gateway, NAT device or public IP Private access to services
AWS Global Accelerator Two static IP addresses; routes users over the AWS global network to the best healthy endpoint Global performance and failover

Exam tip: A hub for networks: Transit Gateway. Private service access: PrivateLink. Static IPs and global routing: Global Accelerator.

Amazon API Gateway: The Front Door for APIs

  • Amazon API Gateway creates, publishes, maintains, monitors and secures APIs at any scale: REST, HTTP and WebSocket
  • It is a "front door" to backends such as AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2 or any web application
  • It handles traffic management, authorization, access control, monitoring and version management
  • Authentication options include IAM policies, Lambda authorizers and Amazon Cognito user pools
  • AWS WAF can protect your APIs from common web exploits
  • With Lambda, it forms the app-facing part of serverless applications

Exam tip: Publish and secure APIs in front of Lambda or other backends: Amazon API Gateway.

What the Exam Asks: Networking

  • Public or private subnet: a route to an internet gateway, or none
  • Internet gateway or NAT gateway: a direct path, or reach out only
  • Security group or network ACL: stateful per resource, or stateless per subnet
  • Route 53 or CloudFront: DNS and health checks, or cached content at the edge
  • VPN or Direct Connect: encrypted over the internet, or a dedicated line
  • Transit Gateway, PrivateLink or Global Accelerator: a hub, private access, or static global IPs
  • API Gateway: a front door for APIs

Exam tip: Name the layer first: network, firewall, DNS, delivery, connection or API.

Design Check: Tidewater's Network Plan

Tidewater's need Choose
Web servers reachable, database not reachable Public and private subnets
Private servers that download updates NAT gateway
Allow only web traffic, with replies automatic Security group
Block one bad IP range at the subnet edge Network ACL with a deny rule
Customers type the shop's domain name Amazon Route 53
Fast page loads in Europe Amazon CloudFront
A quick, encrypted warehouse link Site-to-Site VPN
A dedicated line to the warehouse AWS Direct Connect
Staff working from home AWS Client VPN
  • Cover the right column, answer each row yourself, then compare

Try It: A VPC with Public and Private Subnets (Optional)

  • Goal: see the parts of a VPC in a practice account; a VPC itself is free, but NAT gateways are not
  • In the VPC console choose Create VPC, then VPC and more, with two Availability Zones, public and private subnets, and no NAT gateways
  • Open the route tables: only the public one has a route to the internet gateway
  • Look at the security group and network ACL the wizard created
  • Clean up: delete the VPC

Lists the VPC IDs in the current Region

aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query "Vpcs[].VpcId"

Exam tip: Hands-on work is not tested on this exam, but it makes the network pieces concrete.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer; some ask for two)

S1Which VPC feature acts as a stateful firewall for an EC2 instance, automatically allowing the replies to traffic that it permits?

  • AA network ACL, which works at the subnet level
  • BA NAT gateway, which translates private addresses
  • CA security group, which works at the resource level
  • DAn internet gateway, which links the VPC to the internet
Show the answer

Answer: C. A security group is a stateful virtual firewall for resources such as EC2 instances, so replies to allowed traffic are permitted automatically. A network ACL is stateless and works at the subnet level, and NAT and internet gateways route traffic rather than filter it.

S2Tidewater's application servers are in a private subnet. They must download software updates from the internet, but the internet must not be able to start connections to them. What should Tidewater add?

  • AA NAT gateway in a public subnet, with a route from the private subnet
  • BA route from the private subnet straight to the internet gateway
  • CA public IP address on every application server in the subnet
  • DA network ACL that allows all inbound traffic from the internet
Show the answer

Answer: A. A NAT gateway lets instances in a private subnet reach the internet while the internet cannot start connections to them. A direct route to the internet gateway or public IP addresses would make the servers reachable, and allowing all inbound traffic does the same.

S3Which AWS service is a highly available DNS web service that can register domain names, route internet traffic to resources and check their health?

  • AAmazon CloudFront, a content delivery network
  • BAWS Global Accelerator, which provides static IP addresses
  • CAmazon API Gateway, a front door for APIs
  • DAmazon Route 53, a DNS web service
Show the answer

Answer: D. Route 53 performs domain registration, DNS routing and health checking. CloudFront caches content at edge locations, Global Accelerator routes traffic over the AWS network to endpoints, and API Gateway manages APIs.

S4Tidewater wants its images, scripts and pages delivered quickly to customers worldwide by caching them near the customers. Which service should it use?

  • AAWS Direct Connect, a dedicated line to a data center
  • BAmazon CloudFront, a content delivery network
  • CA NAT gateway, which lets private servers reach out
  • DAWS Transit Gateway, a hub for connecting networks
Show the answer

Answer: B. CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches static and dynamic content at edge locations and serves each request from the lowest-latency one. Direct Connect, a NAT gateway and Transit Gateway connect networks rather than deliver cached content.

S5Which TWO statements about connecting an on-premises network to AWS are correct? (Select TWO.)

  • AAWS Site-to-Site VPN is an encrypted IPsec connection that runs over the internet
  • BAWS Direct Connect runs over the public internet like a standard VPN
  • CAWS Direct Connect is a dedicated connection that bypasses internet service providers
  • DAWS Client VPN joins two data centers with a dedicated fiber cable
  • EAWS Site-to-Site VPN needs a dedicated fiber connection to an AWS location
Show the answer

Answer: A, C. Site-to-Site VPN carries encrypted IPsec tunnels over the internet, while Direct Connect is a dedicated connection that bypasses internet service providers. Client VPN connects individual users rather than data centers, and only Direct Connect needs a dedicated connection.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
VPC an isolated network; subnets live in one Availability Zone; public subnets route to an internet gateway
Gateways an internet gateway for a direct path; a NAT gateway for outbound-only access
Firewalls security groups are stateful and per resource; network ACLs are stateless and per subnet
DNS and delivery Route 53 for domains and health checks; CloudFront for cached content at the edge
Connections Site-to-Site VPN over the internet, Client VPN for users, Direct Connect for a dedicated line
Others Transit Gateway hub, PrivateLink private access, Global Accelerator static IPs, API Gateway for APIs
